name: Crashocker

debut.episode: Let's Do the Time War Again

abilities: Electrokinesis: releases electric shock waves on landing
Horned skull used as a battering ram
weaknesses: No weaknesses documented on the wiki
Attacks are close-range and momentum-based (jump, ram, land)
summary: Ben 10,000's Biomnitrix fusion of Crashhopper and Shocksquatch: a brownish-green electric grasshopper-sasquatch that leaps in, head-butts, and discharges lightning on landing.
traits: 'That's just the way the bug bounces.'
notableFeats: Battled and defeated Exo-Skull (Let's Do the Time War Again)

appearances.firstEpisode: Let's Do the Time War Again
notableEpisodes: Let's Do the Time War Again
appearances.designNotes: Shocksquatch's chest, torso and arm structure recoloured brownish-green; Crashhopper's upper head and horn with Shocksquatch's chin; Crashhopper's legs with two bolts on each foot; Crashhopper's green clothing and abdomen; three bolts on the neck; Biomnitrix symbol on the stomach.

scoring.rationale: Crashhopper's leaping and ram head plus Shocksquatch's electricity delivered as landing shock waves, and enough muscle to beat Exo-Skull easily. A capable mid-tier fighter with one appearance and short-range, momentum-dependent attacks.

notes: One-time form used only by the Omniverse Ben 10,000 via the Biomnitrix (Let's Do the Time War Again, OV S8).

Biomnitrix context: the Omniverse Ben 10,000 (Original Future timeline, re-established as Ben Prime's true future) wears two linked Omnitrix gauntlets; slamming them together fuses two aliens on the fly (combinations are generated at transformation time, not stored). Each gauntlet alone gives normal aliens; it is voice-controlled and can be knocked out by a large EMP or Chronosapien time-freeze. All on-screen fusions were drawn by Thomas N. Perkins IV; the device name was coined by Derrick J. Wyatt (unnamed in scripts).
